bagPolicy.summary: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is no public parking available at or around Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Visitors are advised not to drive to events due to parking restrictions and the operation of tow trucks. Cycling is encouraged with ample cycle parking available.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Tottenham Hotspur Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including hot food, salads, barista coffee, and bakery goods at the M Café, which is open daily except on event days. Special event menus and exclusive items like loaded nachos and doughnuts are available during specific events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Mobility aids can be stored at accessible entrances 1, 5 and 17 for these events. Changing Places provisions are located in the Tottenham Experience, at block 105 and in the East Atrium, all accessed with a radar key.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Tottenham Hotspur Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Mobility aids can be stored at accessible entrances 1, 5 and 17 for these events.
